summary.text: You can withdraw CPFIS investments if you have set aside the FRS. Otherwise, you can only liquidate them.

details.heading: If you have set aside the FRS
details.body: Apply through the Investment dashboard. Close your CPF Investment Account with your agent bank and cease CPFIS participation. Investments will be converted to cash investments in your personal accounts. The account balance, if any, will be paid to you in cash.

details.heading: If you have not set aside the FRS
details.body: You cannot withdraw your CPFIS investments. You can liquidate them instead. The sale proceeds will return to your CPF accounts.

details.heading: Processing time
details.body: Agent banks and product providers generally take about 1 to 2 weeks to process the withdrawal.

quotes.text: If you have set aside the Full Retirement Sum (FRS) in your Retirement Account, you can apply to withdraw your CPFIS
To apply, please submit your application through the Investment dashboard.
If you have not set aside the FRS in your Retirement Account, you would not be able to withdraw your CPFIS investments.
Generally, the agent banks/product providers will take about 1- 2 weeks for processing.
